regions.name: Barents Sea & Svalbard
regions.why: The Arctic warms faster than the rest of the planet; its sea ice is retreating.

T2M.label: Air temperature
T2M.simple: How warm the air is 2 metres above the ground — what a thermometer in the shade shows.

FRSEAICE.label: Sea ice cover
FRSEAICE.simple: The share of the ocean surface covered by floating sea ice: 0 % is open water, 100 % is fully frozen over.

TS.label: Surface temperature
TS.simple: The temperature of the surface itself — soil, rock, sea water or ice — which can be much hotter or colder than the air above it.

SNODP.label: Snow depth
SNODP.simple: How deep the snow lying on the ground is, in centimetres.

PRECTOTCORR.label: Precipitation
PRECTOTCORR.simple: How much rain and snow falls, in millimetres of water per day (1 mm on one square metre is one litre). MERRA-2 corrects its model rain with rain gauges and satellite observations.

SLP.label: Sea-level pressure
SLP.simple: The weight of the air above a spot, as if measured at sea level (about 1013 hPa on average): low pressure brings storms, high pressure fair weather.

links.text: Air temperature and Surface temperature leave their norm in the same months, the same way: 122 times, where chance at the same moment of the record would give 57 (p = 2e-25; z = 11.6 against the same reading with one of them moved 1 to 5 years, beyond the shared trend and the persistence of each). So often, both ways (82 % and 75 %), that Eva takes them for one dynamic seen through the identity: in 66 months one left its norm without the other.

keywords.definition: Pertaining to the study of frozen seawater over the ocean surface.
Pertains to the measurement of the surface height of the sea ice. Inparticular, sea ice elevation is measured by the radar altimeter on board theNASA IceSat satellite.
Refers to the movement and direction of ice fields or floes. Icemotion processes include: diverging, compacting, and shearing.

Eva's dynamics, read year by year: one steady dynamic from 1981 to 2025 (-3.5 per decade): no change of regime stands out from the year-to-year swings.
